nfhs5.dataset: National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5), District Fact Sheets
nfhs5.publisher: International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) & Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
nfhs5.coverage: 705 districts across 28 States and 8 Union Territories (fieldwork 2019-21)
nfhs5.extraction: Machine-readable extract by J. Varghese, github.com/jvargh7/nfhs5_factsheets (MIT licence for the extraction code/data files; values transcribed from official factsheets; maintainer notes values have not been extensively cross-checked).
nfhs5.license: Government of India public statistical release; extraction MIT. Attribute IIPS/MoHFW.
nfhs5.notes: Values with inadequate sample size ('*') or not available ('na') are missing, not imputed.

census2011.dataset: Census of India 2011 — Primary Census Abstract and Houselisting & Housing (district level)
census2011.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
census2011.coverage: 640 Census-2011 districts. Joined only to districts whose boundary is unchanged since 2011; newer districts show population as UNAVAILABLE.
census2011.extraction: District CSV compiled by github.com/nishusharma1608/India-Census-2011-Analysis (derived from Census of India tables).
census2011.license: Government of India public statistical release. Compilation repository states no licence; underlying figures are official Census tables.
census2011.notes: Population is 15 years old. Used for exposure weighting and signal-rate denominators only.

boundaries.dataset: Indian district boundaries (734 districts recognised in 2019), TopoJSON
boundaries.publisher: Guneet Narula, based on DataMeet community maps and contributions by Aaditya Dar, Justin Elliot Meyers, Abhijeet
boundaries.coverage: All India, 734 district polygons (Saitual, Mizoram absent)
boundaries.license: MIT (repository licence). For visualisation; not an authoritative survey boundary.
boundaries.notes: Includes the full territorial extent of India as depicted by Government of India. Polygons with no statistical data are shown as INSUFFICIENT DATA.

synthetic_demand.dataset: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION SIGNAL — generated citizen-report counts
synthetic_demand.notes: Not collected from citizens. Deterministic seeded generator; see data/metadata/model.json > synthetic_demand. Replace with a real grievance feed (e.g. state CPGRAMS / 1076 / municipal helpline exports) in production.
